title: Photon Bench
blurb: A seven-stage optics puzzle: place 45-degree mirrors on a breadboard to steer 638, 589, 532 and 447 nm beams past beam dumps, through dichroic gates that pass only their own wavelength, and into the matching photodiode. The solver is a memoised walk over (cell, direction, wavelength), so a beam that mirrors loop back into itself terminates instead of spinning forever - and two beams crossing the same empty square pass clean through each other, which the last stage depends on.
